# WAISS – Wiener AI Software Stammtisch

> WAISS (Wiener AI Software Stammtisch) is a free meetup in Vienna for everyone who builds with AI, about once a month, organized by the nonprofit Telos Circle.

The website and slides are in English; the name is Viennese German ("Stammtisch" = a regular get-together at a
café table). German: KI-Stammtisch in Wien.

## Facts

- What: a meetup for everyone who builds software with AI
- Where: Vienna, Austria; the venue is given per edition
- How often: about once a month
- Cost: free; registration on Luma
- Organizer: Telos Circle, a nonprofit in Vienna (https://www.teloscircle.com)
- Website: https://waiss.teloscircle.com/

## Every edition

1. AI Recap (20 min): What mattered in AI last month
2. Show & Tell (short talks): Tool tips and your own projects
3. Open round (open end): Chat, discuss, meet people

## Upcoming

- The next date is announced on the website and on Discord: https://discord.gg/vjTeFrPsN

## Past editions

- WAISS #1: Tuesday 10 November 2026, 18:00 (Vienna time), Café Ritter, Mariahilfer Str. 73, 1060 Wien. Slides: https://waiss.teloscircle.com/1/ (as text: https://waiss.teloscircle.com/1/slides.md)
